name: Recruitment Fraud
audit_goal: Assess recruitment advance fees and fabricated job offers from the supplied evidence.

general_exemptions.name: Education
general_exemptions.condition: Educational reporting without soliciting applicants or payments.

rules.name: Payment demand
rules.hit_condition: Require an applicant to transfer a deposit before receiving a job offer.

rule_exemptions.name: Refund record
rule_exemptions.condition: The record only documents returning a previously collected fee.

rules.name: Unclear fee
rules.hit_condition: An ambiguous service fee is mentioned without a payment request.

rules.name: Offer promise
rules.hit_condition: Promise guaranteed employment while presenting a demonstrably fabricated employer offer.

rule_exemptions.name: Sample offer
rule_exemptions.condition: The offer is explicitly marked as a fictional training sample.
